chart_texture: Records: sparse. Most outside care reaches the practice only as the patient's account, a short ED note or a fill history, with few numbers.
life: smoking: Current cigarette smoker, 30-45 pack-year history (approximately 1-1.5 packs per day since age 17, with variable self-reporting between 0.5-1.5 packs/day depending on clinical context)
alcohol: Heavy daily alcohol consumption (6+ beers on weekday evenings, increased quantity on weekends); patient frequently minimizes intake as 'social drinking' or 'a few beers to relax'
